title: Pool! Walk to Gulch & Broadway! Balcony ! Parking!
description:
Experience the best of Nashville in this 1,226 SQ. Ft. Penthouse Loft, just steps from the Gulch, Downtown and Vanderbilt!

With 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 5 beds (King bed, Queen Bunks, Sofa pull out Queen & Twin Bed) it comfortably sleeps 8!  
Enjoy a massive 1,000 sq ft private patio with a couch, chaise lounges, outdoor dining area, yard games, and a bar!   

Heated pool, gym and shared BBQ area!

This property is set up and ready for an amazing time!  

Nashville S.T.R. Permit-#2025080729

The space
This incredibly spacious 1,226 SQ foot loft overlooks the Gulch.  The condo has a Primary Bedroom with a Kind Bed, a second bedroom with queen bunk beds, a built in twin bed in the living room and a queen bed pull out couch. 

Hang out on your private 1,000 SQ Ft complete with games, chaise lounges, bar and multiple seating areas. 

This Penthouse Loft is ready to entertain you and your guests for your next stay in Nashville!
